channel.title: FFIP LinkedIn rotation
channel.description: Fly Fishing Insider Podcast articles queued for LinkedIn

item.title: Panhandle Tarpon with David Mangum | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Florida Panhandle guide David Mangum on why tarpon follow menhaden, how river flow drives the fishery, and the unwritten etiquette of tarpon water.

item.title: Chasing Every Salmonid Species | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: A guest on a mission to catch every salmonid species shares how to find rare native trout and char: go up, research hard, keep rigs simple.

item.title: Coastal Rivers for Native Trout | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: A river ecologist explains how woody debris, shade, rain-fed flows and water temperature shape coastal cutthroat water, and how to fish it smarter.

item.title: Telescoping Fly Rods: What Collapsible Rods Actually Do Well | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Telescoping fly rods trade a little casting finesse for the ability to fish water you'd otherwise drive past. Here's how they work and who should own one.

item.title: Fly Fishing Australia: Barramundi, Murray Cod and Blue Bastards | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Josh Hutchins of Aussie Fly Fisher on barra drains, topwater Murray cod, bite-tippet leaders and why Australia is a fly angler's playground.

item.title: How IGFA Fly Fishing Records Actually Work | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: A multiple IGFA record holder breaks down tippet class, certified tippet, bump boards and photo rules, and why a record isn't real until IGFA says so.

item.title: Living on a Sailboat and Fly Fishing for Your Food | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: A former Arctic fly fishing guide trades land for a sailboat, planning to fly fish for his food on the way to Scotland. Lessons for coastal anglers.

item.title: Six Casts in Six Hours: Hunting Big Brown Trout the Stealthy Way | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Guide Matt McCannel hunts trophy browns with six casts in six hours. Here's the stealth, rehearsal, and patience system behind targeting one big fish.

item.title: Michigan's Other Fishery: Fly Fishing for Smallmouth and Pike | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Everyone goes to Michigan for trout. The native smallmouth and pike are hiding in plain sight. Rod angle, wire leaders, and streamer tactics that work.

item.title: How to Read a Fly Reel Spec Sheet | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Large arbor, sealed drag, machined vs. die-cast. What those reel specs actually mean on the water, and which ones matter for the fish you're chasing.

item.title: DIY Destination Fly Fishing: Why the Trip of a Lifetime Shouldn't Be Once in a Lifetime | Fly Fishing Insider Podcast, Blog and Shop
item.description: Skip the week-long lodge package. How to plan a self-guided Belize flats trip or a mothership float in Argentina without treating it as the one big trip you ever take.

item.title: Fly Tying Profession with Garrett Lesko
item.description: Step into the fly tying profession and learn a little from a North West local Garrett Lesko. We cover the ins and outs and everything between

item.title: Why Your Fly Cast Isn't Really a Loop
item.description: A forestry scientist's unconventional wave theory of fly casting, and practical drills that sharpen your stroke.

item.title: Terrestrial Dry Fly Fishing: Ants, Beetles, Hoppers
item.description: How to fish ant, beetle, and hopper patterns through late summer, including presentation tricks that beat a standard dead drift.

item.title: Night Fly Fishing Tactics for Trophy Trout
item.description: Night fly fishing for stillwater trophy trout: where big fish move after dark, the flies and lines that work blind, and how to fish safely at night.
